photos.c: THE COUNTY CHAMPIONSHIPS. Tony Brooks (41) 46th, John Kelly (45) 31st and Richard Moody (46) 36th seen competing in the Youth's Race. Adrian Major (18) and John Martin (20) were 16th and 45th respectively in the Junior event.

John Martin heaves the 16lb shot 11.55 metres whilst representing Lambeth against Vincennes and Castrop Rauxel at the Crystal Palace on 28th April. He was placed 3rd behind Yves Brouzet, the Frenchman who was 12th in Munich, and the German Jack Forst.

Top left. Glyn Ratcliffe, here putting the shot, recently improved our Club Discus record to 48.50m. It had stood since 1956. Top right. Philip Gee, one lap specialist and down to 51.6 this summer. Bottom left. John Martin improved his best Javelin throw to 50.32m in the Club Champs. Bottom right. Belgrave's answer to 'Hercules Unchained' - Eric Barker.
'Heavy Boys' at the Boxing Day Meeting. Left to right - Peter North, Peter Crosbie, Steve Crosbie, Cliff Brooks, John Martin (kneeling), guest, guest, Bill Couzens.

Left: Part of the Belgrave T&F Team of '67 pose with President Frank Jarvis at the end of a successful season.
Back row: Brian King (throws), Chris Keavey (middle distance), Bill Couzens (throws), Don McLean (middle-distance and steeplechase), Frank Jarvis, Nick Head (javelin), Bob Taylor (Team Manager), Bill Dance (middle distance), Adrian Major (middle distance), Alan Black (middle-distance and steeplechase).
Front: John Mitchell (long jump and sprints), Phil Smith sprints John Martin (throws), Tony Brooks (440/880), Alan Mead 440/880).

Above: The 70s and a photo call after a Young Athletes Sunday morning training session at Wimbledon Park. The adults, left of the group, left to right are: John Martin, Frank Simmons, Jim Heathfield (crouching), Bob Taylor, Reg. Hopkins Jnr., Reg Hopkins Snr. And on the right: John Baker, Philip Gee, Peter Hilliar, Gordon Biscoe, Mickey Pyer, Gordon Doubleday, Alan Mead and Bill Couzens.
